programme.title: Big Snowman, Little Snowman
programme.desc: Join the main characters of Frozen as they demonstrate a variety of fun and silly opposites.

programme.title: The Surprise Party
programme.desc: This show features fun stories about Disney and Pixar animal friends. Read about fire pups, camping, school days, and more. Enjoy word-for-word narration, perfect for any time!

programme.title: Going Batty
programme.desc: In 'Going Batty,' the new girl in town is looking forward to make new friends! But when her family's strange ways spook the neighbors, Vampirina goes a little batty trying to scare up a play date.

programme.title: Goofy At Bat
programme.desc: It's baseball season, and Goofy can't wait to try out for the team. If only he knew how to play baseball! Join in the fun as Goofy's friends teach him how to bat, run the bases, and catch.

programme.title: Wings Around The Globe
programme.desc: Dusty Crophopper a speed-loving crop duster who dreams of competing in around-the-world air race. With the support of his friends, Dusty live his dreams and gives the world the inspiration to soar.

programme.title: Kiss The Frog
programme.desc: Tiana and Prince Naveen turned into frogs and became lost in a Louisiana bayou. They only have Cajun Firefly, an alligator that plays the trumpet, as a friend.

programme.title: A Horse To Love: An Enchanted Stables Story
programme.desc: Join on an a-neigh-zing ride with their beloved horses. Gallop with Belle and Phillipe, compete in a horse show with Cinderella and Frou, and trot through the forest with Snow White and Astor.

programme.title: Elsa's Perfect Plan
programme.desc: 32-page storybook a prequel to the short film Frozen Fever

programme.title: Hawaii Pug-O
programme.desc: In Hawaii Pug-O, Bingo and Rolly's adventures lead them all the way to the Aloha State in this storybook with word for word narration.

programme.title: One Amazing Chef
programme.desc: Remy, a rat with a flair for cooking, pairs up with young klutz named Linguini to make him a star chef. Follow along as Remy and Linguini work together to make the best food in Paris!

programme.title: A Friend In The Wild
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! What if the cataclysmic asteroid that forever changed life on Earth actually missed the planet completely and giant dinosaurs never became extinct?

programme.title: Happy Birthday Mike
programme.desc: It's almost Mike's birthday and Sulley wants to plan something special. All your favorite pals from Monsters Inc. and Monsters University want to join in on the monster birthday bash, too. Follow them.

programme.title: Thumper Finds A Friend
programme.desc: Thumper and his friends have six cute adventures! This sweet Disney storybook collection is perfect for reading aloud. Enjoy the word-for-word narration at bedtime or anytime!

programme.title: Cloud Country
programme.desc: Sitting there, among the clouds, looking down and day dreaming is... a little cloudlet. Gale would like nothing more than to make one real cloud shape. But instead, she creates something different.

programme.title: Lava
programme.desc: Inspired by the isolated beauty of tropical islands and the explosive allure of ocean volcanoes, LAVA is a love story that takes place over millions of years.

programme.title: Over There
programme.desc: Over There is a drama series following six young American soldiers facing the horrors of the Iraq War, dealing with combat, injuries, and personal challenges during their tour of duty.

programme.title: All Stuffed Up
programme.desc: Doc diagnoses Teddy B with a case of the 'Dusty-Musties.' His dust triggers allergies! Doc runs Teddy B through the washing machine. Once he's dust-free, Doc gives Teddy B back to her little brother.

programme.title: Brave Dragon
programme.desc: While playing with Doc and the other toys, Stuffy takes a spill in the park and gets covered in prickly burs. Doc fixes him up, but something is not right...Stuffy doesn't want to play!

programme.title: Blame It On The Rain
programme.desc: Alma's stuffed cow, Moo Moo, gets soaked when she is left outside in the rain. Alma is sad and Moo Moo is mooo-serable! Can Doc help?

programme.title: Brontosaurus Breath
programme.desc: After Donny 'feeds' his toy dino, Bronty, a salami sandwich for lunch, all the other toys run and hide. Doc diagnoses Bronty with Stinkysalamibreath, his breath is just too smelly to be around!

programme.title: Caught Blue-Handed
programme.desc: Chilly arrives in Doc's clinic covered with blue spots! Doc has to track down the reason for this case of Mystery Pox and help her friend Chilly.

programme.title: Peaches Pie, Take A Bath
programme.desc: In this Level Pre-1 Reader, Alma's doll, Peaches Pie, loses its lovely scent after being dragged by Rudy's dog, Doc.

programme.title: Starry Starry Night
programme.desc: One starry night, Doc's friend, Henry, brings his brand-new toy telescope, to Doc's house to watch a meteor shower. Right before the shower begins, Henry discovers that his telescope isn't working.

programme.title: Take Your Pet To The Vet
programme.desc: Doc's hamster, Coleslaw, needs a checkup. But there's one problem . . . Coleslaw isn't a toy, so it's time to take this pet to the vet! .

programme.title: Engine Nine, Feelin' Fine
programme.desc: Donny doesn't want to play with his favorite toy fire engine, Lenny, anymore. So it's up to Doc to figure out what's wrong. Turns out, Lenny ran out of water for his fire engine hose.

programme.title: The Mermaid Dives In
programme.desc: When Doc brings her swimming toy, Melinda the Mermaid, into the pool, she sinks right to the bottom. Doc gives her a check-up and fixes her up...but Melinda still sinks!

programme.title: A Knight In Sticky Armor
programme.desc: Doc McStuffins doesn't just play with her toys-she heals them! Kids love this six-year-old doctor. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Doc McStuffins cures her brother's knight, Sir Kirby.

programme.title: A Very Mcstuffins Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas Eve is full of surprises at the McStuffins house! The toys sneak downstairs. They find Tobias. Tobias accidentally drops Donny's toy and breaks it! Can Doc fix the toy before Christmas?

programme.title: Bella'S Big Break
programme.desc: Doc McStuffins helps Bella the ballerina doll overcome her fear after breaking her leg. With friends' support, Bella learns to dance again, proving courage and care can heal both body and spirit.

programme.title: Bubble Trouble
programme.desc: Doc loves popping bubbles with her friends Emmie and Alma, but when their toy Bubble Monkey runs out of bubble soap, there are no bubbles to pop.

programme.title: Chilly Catches A Cold
programme.desc: One snowy morning, Doc and the toys venture outside for fun. But when Chilly begins to feel like a real frozen snowman, Doc diagnoses him with a case of 'Brrrrritis.' The cure: Chilly needs to warm up!

programme.title: Dad'S Favorite Toy
programme.desc: A touching family tale about a father's favorite toy, exploring themes of nostalgia, love, and emotional connections that bridge generations with joy and memories.

programme.title: Jingle Bell Doc
programme.desc: Doc's cherished toy, Jingle Bell Bear, breaks before Christmas. The toys, realizing Doc's kindness, create a special surprise for her with Jingle Bell's help.

programme.title: Leilani's Luau
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When Doc receives Leilani, a solar-powered hula girl, from her grandmother who is traveling in Hawaii, Doc and the toys decide to welcome the hula dancer with a luau.

programme.title: Pet Vet
programme.desc: Doc McStuffins must diagnose Fetchin' Findo, Donny's new toy dog, when he malfunctions during a game. She prepares her veterinary clinic for the task.

programme.title: Shake Your Tail Feathers
programme.desc: 'Shake a Tail Feather' is a funky song in Chicken Little's end credits, performed by The Cheetah Girls, getting everyone to dance and groove.

programme.title: Smitten With A Kitten
programme.desc: After Doc finds a toy kitten, she brings her home to meet the toys. Lambie falls in love with the little kitty and wants to adopt her. But anytime Lambie or the toys come close, the kitten runs away!

programme.title: Training Army Al
programme.desc: Donny is going on his camping trip, and only the bravest toy can go with him. Army Al volunteers. Follow along with word-for-word narration to see if Doc and the toys can help Army Al train hard.

programme.title: Loud Louie
programme.desc: Doc finds her old toy cell phone, Louie, in the toy box, and discovers that his volume control is stuck in the 'loud' position, which makes games like 'Hide and Seek' and 'Telephone' a little tricky.

programme.title: Dumbo'S Snowy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this collection of cuddly Disney stories, even the smallest readers are sure to be lulled into sleep with stories of friendship and love.

programme.title: Dumbo
programme.desc: A beautiful picture book captures the essence of Tim Burton's Dumbo. Enjoy stunning visuals that bring Walt Disney's live-action Dumbo to life.

programme.title: Isabella's School Adventure
programme.desc: When Isabel returns to school and discovers that her smart ways make her unpopular, she tries changing herself in order to fit in. Find out if Isabel can make new friends but still be true to herself.

programme.title: The Secret Spell Book
programme.desc: Mateo gets put to the test when his grandfather's secret spell book is stolen! Will Mateo save the day and proves his worth as the new royal wizard of Avalor?

programme.title: A Day To Remember
programme.desc: Elena loves celebrating Dia de los Muertos-The Day of the Dead-in Avalor. It's a day of remembrance to honor and celebrate her ancestors.

programme.title: Elena And Naomi's Big Adventure
programme.desc: Elena and her friend Naomi go on a dig and discover that hundreds of magical, mischievous creatures are about to descend upon Avalor, threatening to wreak havoc! Naomi's abilities will be put to the test.

programme.title: Song Of The Sirenas
programme.desc: Elena visits the West Coast of Avalor, meets mysterious underwater creatures called sirenas, and encounters the evil sorceress Shuriki once again!

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Winston the Boston Terrier loves his life with his owner, especially the shared snacks. But a new girlfriend brings healthier food, changing their routine .

programme.title: Dory's Story
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Dory does not have a good memory. Can she remember how to get home? Follow along with the word for word narration to find out!

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: John awakens from a coma to discover his wife and daughter were murdered in a brutal home invasion. Haunted by images of the attack, he vows to kill the man responsible: The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a Uni Sol in relentless pursuit.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer after making a shocking discovery of a woman being held captive. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

programme.title: Doosri Dulhan
programme.desc: Renu and her husband, Anil, are devastated when she cannot bear children after a miscarriage. But soon, he visits a brothel and asks young Chanda to carry and give birth to a baby for his family.

programme.title: Beti
programme.desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.

programme.title: Khuddar
programme.desc: Hari is forced to marry Seema, who dislikes his stepbrothers, Govind and Rajesh. When he goes to Mumbai, she displaces them to become beggars. However, destiny reunites them with Hari in a courtroom.

programme.title: Gunda Gardi
programme.desc: A righteous police commissioner, Karan Singh, tries to nab the notorious mafia duo, Narasimha and Kalicharan. After his brother-in-law gets murdered, he plans to take help from the eye-witness, Deepa, to get hold of the criminals.

programme.title: Love Sex Aur Dhoka
programme.desc: An Indian anthology film that tells three separate but interconnected stories revolving around the themes of love, sex, and betrayal. The film is shot in a found-footage style, utilizing surveillance cameras, mobile phones, and webcams to capture the stories of individuals from different backgrounds, whose lives are intertwined in unexpected ways. It explores the dark side of relationships and the impact of technology on modern romance.

programme.title: Maqbool
programme.desc: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.
